correctness.rationale: Write \(A=u^q-u\), \(B=1+A^{q-1}\) and \(N=q^n+1\). The exact derivative identity is \(f'= -B^{r-1}\), giving the Gauss coordinates \([1:(u^{q^2}-u)/z:-u^{q^2}]\). With \(w=c^{-1/q}z^{q^{n-1}}/B^{(r-1)/q}\), the field calculation \(K=k(u^q,w)\), \(k(C^\vee)=k(u^{q^2},w^q)=K^q\) proves purely inseparable degree exactly \(q\). Pole orders at the unique infinity give pullback degree \(Nq^2\), hence dual degree \(Nq\). The Jacobian and local parameter computations give \(q^2-q\) cusps of type \(Y^N=X^r\) with coprime exponents. Their delta sum reproduces the known geometric genus. The checker verifies only bounded instances.
